  "overall_experience": "The IT intern found Xero to be a generally effective tool for managing the school's accounting and payment processing needs. Its ease of use and cloud accessibility were significant advantages, allowing for efficient electronic transactions and book balancing. While it capably handled core tasks, they noted some room for improvement in advanced reporting and occasional technical hiccups."
